t: What he asked for when they came to him crying
a: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعاً نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
p: Allāhumma-sqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿan nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārrin ʿājilan ghayra ājil
m: O Allah, water us with rain that relieves, wholesome, filling the pasture, useful and not harmful, soon and not delayed.
